svg.text: McCzarny recently enhanced his
chromium-daily-digest project by adding a
GitHub Actions workflow for publishing pages
and refactoring the service to limit concurrent
fetches. He also introduced UI improvements
like remembering the last read date and
keyboard navigation. In dcvis, he significantly
expanded data visualization with a new "Power
Plant Scale" tab to compare data center energy
consumption with power plant blocks. He also
implemented an "energy" layer for comparing
electricity usage and added detailed
information and visualizations about
groundwater productivity. Updates were made to
water usage calculations, specifying direct
consumption and separating it visually from
total usage. Further refinements in dcvis
included updating the noise simulation display,
unifying units, and redoing the methodology
panel. For his crater-js game, he added a Cilia
Hauler mob and implemented basic impatience
mechanics. He also improved the game's UI with
better item handling and numeric key character
selection. Additionally, he tuned movement,
added more complex difficulty logic, and
created bedrock for crater-js. His diverse
activity spans web development, data
visualization, and game development.
